name: Easy Album Gallery
author: delweratjk

sections.installation:
1. Upload the easy-album-gallery folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to “Easy Album Gallery” in your admin menu to start creating albums.
  4. Use the provided shortcode or the Elementor/Gutenberg integrations to display your gallery.
sections.faq:
How do I use the shortcode?

Simply use [easy-album-gallery type="style_name"]. Available types are: default, flip, grid, masonry, slider, overlay, hexagon, parallax, metro, magazine.

Is it compatible with Elementor?

Yes! There is a dedicated “Easy Album Gallery” widget in Elementor with all styles available.

  • Major Overhaul: Added 10 total gallery styles with unique layouts.

sections.description:
Easy Album Gallery is a powerful WordPress plugin that allows you to create stunning, professional photo galleries in minutes. With 10 distinct gallery styles, full Elementor and Gutenberg support, and a premium glassmorphic lightbox, it’s the ultimate solution for photographers and designers. Showcase your stories with beautiful overlays, interactive flip cards, cinematic parallax effects, and smooth carousels. Designed for performance and visual excellence.

Features

  • 10 Premium Gallery Styles: From classic grids to cinematic parallax and magazine layouts.
  • Premium Modal/Lightbox: Redesigned with glassmorphism, smooth animations, and detailed info panels.
  • Full Elementor Integration: Custom widget with real-time preview and extensive controls.
  • Gutenberg Ready: Integrated block for a seamless editing experience in the native WordPress editor.
  • Masonry Support: Automatically balanced grid layouts with consistent image heights.
  • Responsive & Mobile Optimized: Every style and the modal adapt perfectly to all screen sizes.
  • Flickity Integration: Ultra-smooth touch-enabled sliders for both gallery items and the popup.
  • Modern Aesthetics: Gradient overlays, deep shadows, and premium typography.
  • Cross Browser Compatibility: Works perfectly on Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge.

10 Distinct Gallery Styles

  1. Default Grid: Clean, modern responsive grid.
  2. Flip Cards: Interactive 3D flip animation revealing album details.
  3. Simple Grid: Minimalist and elegant presentation.
  4. Masonry Layout: Dynamic grid with beautifully balanced image covers.
  5. Slider/Carousel: Full-height horizontal slider with custom nav.
  6. Overlay Cards: Full-image cards with content sliding up on hover.
  7. Spotlight Rows: Premium alternating rows of images and descriptions.
  8. Cinematic Parallax: Wide format cards with deep zoom parallax effects.
  9. Metro Tiles: Clean, Windows-inspired tight tile grid.
  10. Magazine Editorial: Elegant blog-style cards with date stamps and excerpts.
